# Third-party notices

The shared project-icon code in this package is bundled into every plugin that
imports it (Cursor Sidebar and Projects).

## Hugeicons

`src/project-icon-glyphs.ts` imports icon artwork from
**@hugeicons/core-free-icons** (https://hugeicons.com), used under the MIT
License below. The artwork is served to the browser by each plugin's server
(`src/project-icon-glyph-server.ts`). Icon names follow Cursor's project icon
picker; no artwork, SVG paths or icon font comes from Cursor.

## T3 Code

The following are adapted from **T3 Code** (https://github.com/pingdotgg/t3code),
used under the MIT License below. That project's checkout was treated as
read-only; only source was read and adapted.

- `project-icon.css`: the 18-colour palette, kept so saved icons in those
  colours still show.
- `src/project-icon.ts`: monogram validation and the stored emoji and monogram
  forms, kept for parsing saved values.
